resources.string: Choose a verified JASTREAMER Server on your network. Connections are always your choice; playback stays on the Server.
Use HTTP only on a trusted private LAN. HTTPS certificate checks cannot be disabled.
Searching the local network. If no server appears, check Wi-Fi and multicast or enter its address.
Enter an HTTP(S) server root address without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
The server could not be reached. Check its address and the network.
The HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Use a trusted certificate matching the server address.
The server redirected discovery. Enter its final root address explicitly.
The server returned an unsuccessful HTTP response.
The server returned invalid discovery information.
This is not a compatible JASTREAMER Server.
The server identity changed. This saved connection was not opened.
App preferences could not be read or saved. The change was not applied.
Local network discovery failed. Check Wi-Fi, multicast and app network access, or enter the server address.

This Android System WebView cannot isolate server sessions. Update Android System WebView or Chrome using your device settings or app store, then reopen jastreamer. No shared-session fallback is allowed.
The server interface could not be loaded. Verify the connection again.
Navigation outside the selected server is blocked. Copy reference links and open them in your browser yourself.
